title: Brighter Super shifts focus towards lifetime retirement income
full_text:
Brighter Super is seeking to tackle one of the superannuation system’s biggest challenges by developing a retirement income product that allows eligible members to begin building lifetime income benefits before they retire.
The member-owned fund said the proposed solution would enable members to accrue future lifetime income benefits during the accumulation phase, while maintaining flexibility over how their super is invested.
It said the approach is intended to provide greater certainty in retirement, potentially improve Age Pension outcomes depending on individual circumstances, and give members more choice in how they structure their retirement income.
If successful, the initiative would make Brighter Super the first member-owned super fund to announce the development of this style of retirement product.
The fund said the offering is designed to bridge the gap between accumulating retirement savings and converting those savings into an income that lasts throughout retirement.
Brighter Super’s modelling indicates members could receive between $70,000 and $95,000 in additional income on average over a 25-year retirement.
Chief executive, Kate Farrar, said the industry’s focus now needed to extend beyond helping Australians build larger super balances.
“Australians have become very good at building super balances. The next challenge for our industry is helping people turn those balances into an income that provides confidence throughout retirement.”
She said allowing members to begin preparing for retirement income while they remained in the workforce represented an important step for the member-owned sector.
“Bringing this approach to the member-owned sector is an important step. Rather than waiting until retirement to start thinking about lifetime income, we’re helping members begin preparing and maximising future retirement income outcomes while they’re still working.”
The retirement solution is being developed in partnership with TAL, which will provide the lifetime income guarantee underpinning the product.
TAL chief executive, group life and retirement Jenny Oliver said the partnership was aimed at giving more Australians greater confidence in retirement.
“We’re focused on helping more Australians have a confident retirement. TAL is proud to partner with Brighter Super on this lifetime income solution, because we’re passionate about helping more people plan for retirement and enjoy access to savings that can last for life.”
Brighter Super said the accumulation component is expected to become available to eligible members in the first half of 2027, with the guaranteed lifetime income option planned for 2028.
Additional details, including eligibility requirements and how the accumulation feature will operate, will be released as development progresses.
